item.description: I have an aversion towards pickup trucks, but I try my best to like them. I like the power, the capability, and when they look prim and proper like the Mazda BT-50. item.description: Hyundai Motor Philippines Inc. (HMPH) successfully concluded its “Hope in a Bag” project in collaboration with Knowell PH, a local brand that produces bags out of sustainable materials. item.title: Philippine Government Deals Blow To Local Auto Manufacturing By Removing Support For CARS, RACE Programs
item.description: The Philippine government has dealt a blow to local automotive manufacturing as President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. vetoed support for the Comprehensive Automotive Resurgence Strategy or CARS program and its replacement, the Revitalizing the Automotive Industry for Competitiveness Enhancement (RACE) program.Read More »

item.title: Jetour Auto Reaches 2-Million Sales Milestone
item.description: Last October 2025, Jetour Auto marked a major milestone in its brand journey: surpassing two million cumulative sales since its debut in 2018. Over seven years of steady growth, this achievement reflects strong market recognition and user trust in Jetour’s products and strategy. It also signifies the brand’s solid position in the global automotive landscape and its entry into the top rank of mainstream players.Read More »

item.title: Traffic Is Quietly Raising Our Carbon Footprint And That's Why Going Electric Matters
item.description: Every December, Metro Manila slips into its annual state of carmageddon.
